notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.
